text: How do you think the use of technologies and also sexdolls like Monika make people more distant from each other and what can be done against that?
name: Anonymous

text: The dehumanization of women and their reduction to sexual objects is unambiguous in many of these use cases. What responsibility do parents and educational institutions have to teach, expose, and discuss with students the concepts of empathy, care, compassion, equity, and bodily autonomy?
What kind of future can you foresee/would predict with sex dolls like Monika but powered with AI?
To what degree, if any, should humans be protected against harmful (toxic, isolating, etc.) relationships with AI technologies?

On humans becoming data points: do the purpose of the app (dating, sex) changes the way we interact with each other? And, is the resulting behavior product of the app or of the human nature itself (revealed via the app)?

Anthropomorphism of technology can contribute to para social relationships w/ LLMs. I have a colleague at work who has ChatGPT refer to her as "my goddess". Is there a conversation here to be had about making it clear to laypeople that LLMs are not "real" and do not "feel"?
